metadata.title: Online repair tracking for your customers | ReadyYet
metadata.description: Your customers follow their repair online, from drop-off to pickup, without calling the shop or creating an account. Free 14-day trial.

hero.title: Your customers track their repair online and know when it's ready
hero.lede: Dropped off, being repaired, ready: every step shows up on their phone, with no call to the shop and no account to create.
assurances: Keep the software you already use

steps.title: From drop-off to pickup
steps.intro: You log the item, ReadyYet keeps your customer posted, and they come back at the right time.

step1.title: You log the item
step1.text: At the counter, in seconds: the customer, the item, the expected date. They get their tracking link by email, on WhatsApp or from a QR code they scan on the spot.

step2.title: They follow every step
step2.text: Each step you tick off shows up on their tracking page, along with the expected date and your photos of the item.

step3.title: They come back when it's ready
step3.text: The moment you mark it ready, they get an email. They come to collect it, no wasted trip.

tracking.title: One page with every answer
tracking.text: Current step, expected date, photos of the item, address, opening hours and directions: your customer finds it all in one place.

emails.title: The right email at the right time
emails.text: A quote waiting for an answer, a later date, an item ready: your customer hears about it without you writing a word. If they don't come by, a reminder goes out after 3 and then 10 days.

workflow.title: Your trade's steps
workflow.text: Diagnosis, cleaning, parts on order: ReadyYet starts from your trade's steps, set up the moment you sign up. On Pro, you pick them and set their order.

reviews.title: More Google reviews
reviews.text: On Pro, after pickup, each customer rates their visit and chooses: a Google review, or a private message you answer from ReadyYet.

today.title: Your day at a glance
today.text: Open ReadyYet and see what's ready to hand over, what's running late and what's due today. Customer feedback and pickups to confirm wait for you under “Needs you”.

faq.title: Good to know before you start

app.q: Do my customers need to install an app?
app.a: No. They get a link by email, or scan the QR code you hand them, and follow their item in their browser. No account, no app.

software.q: Do I have to give up my till or shop software?
software.a: No. ReadyYet doesn't replace your till or your management software, it adds tracking for your customers. You log the item at the counter in a few seconds and carry on working as before.

notified.q: How does my customer hear about it?
notified.a: By email: when the item is logged, when a quote or some information is waiting on them, when the expected date moves back and when it's ready, with a reminder if they don't come by. They can also open their tracking page whenever they like.

sms.a: No. Tracking works by email and QR code, which costs nothing extra, for you or your customers. If a customer prefers, you send them their link on WhatsApp in one click.

start.q: How long does it take to get started?
start.a: A few minutes. You create your shop, your trade's steps are already set up, and you log your first Ticket straight away.

afterTrial.q: What happens after the free trial?
afterTrial.a: You pick Essentiel or Pro for each shop. Without a subscription your data stays, but you can't create new Tickets.

shops.a: Yes. Each shop has its own subscription, team and steps, and you switch between them from the same account.

footer.tagline: Online tracking for everything people leave at a shop.
